title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby C) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) -> Cassette (JVC KD-V6/XLII-S90/Dolby C)

ai_review.summary: A superb soundboard recording of an electrifying 1982 show, highlighted by Jerry’s pure tones and standout renditions of Touch of Grey, Estimated Prophet, The Other One and Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The three fan reviews unanimously praise both the performance and the audio. The first set is described as energetic with a “superb” Touch of Grey/Throwing Stones sequence, while the second set delivers tight pacing, gorgeous Morning Dew and an epic The Other One, all captured on an upgraded SBD source that sounds crystal‑clear with excellent stereo separation.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave five stars and highlighted a high‑energy show with multiple standout moments plus an upgraded, crystal‑clear soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the SBD upgrade delivers crisp, clear audio with superb stereo separation and no noticeable flaws; a good matrix version is also available.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds strong energy and rolls into a tightly paced second set; transitions are smooth and the encore caps the night perfectly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is described as pure, soaring, and 'rotopan' wizardry throughout the four‑song stretch, delivering classic mood‑driven solos.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work is praised for its intuition and tight interplay during the spacey improvisations.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s vocal strain is noted but he powers through; his rhythm guitar locks in during the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboards receive compliments for great stereo separation and contributing to the psychedelic textures.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drums are highlighted for taking the reins, providing deep, crisp foundation with excellent channel separation.
